snippet.title: 「Saint Seiya EX」 Pre-order | Officially Licensed Strategy Card RPG
snippet.description: Officially authorized by Toei Animation! The latest Saint Seiya mobile game 「Saint Seiya EX」 is coming in hot! Pre-order now to receive 200 draws for a selectable SSR Gold Saint and the powerful Goddess Saori Kido! Burn! Your Cosmo
